meta.notes: M1's indicators: ATR, 20-day high/low, MAs, OI, momentum, NIFTY's regime. Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}}. Decimals are strings, enums their values, times HH:MM:SS, naive datetimes IST. Config dicts decode by each field's declared type. Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}.
